items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: the Kenny G type of thing?

ctx.x: Did you ever get into what, for lack of a better term nowadays is called contemporary jazz, the Kenny G type of thing?

No. I wasn’t really involved with that. Because my brother had given me tapes of a lot of older styles of music but I didn’t actually go out and actively seek to listen to jazz. Because it wasn’t something I was really interested in until my sophomore year of high school. You know I enjoyed it but I wasn’t actively involved with it. After my sophomore year, and I started to begin to play a lot more, I was concerned about not wanting to sound like a lot of other bass players. I wanted my own individual sound. So I…
